subject: Attorney's Fees
title: PERC AF-2015-005 Final Order (Attorney's Fees)
text:
STATE OF FLORIDA
PUBLIC EMPLOYEES RELATIONS COMMISSION
UNITED FACULTY OF FLORIDA -
SEMINOLE STATE COLLEGE OF
FLORIDA,
Charging Party, Case No. AF- 2015 -005
(Relates to CA- 2014 -090)
v.
FINAL ORDER
SEMINOLE STATE COLLEGE OF
FLORIDA BOARD OF TRUSTEES, Order Number: 15U -299
Date Issued: September 28, 2015
Respondent.
Tobe M. Lev, Orlando, attorney for charging party.
Mark E. Levitt, Winter Park, attorney for respondent.
On September 4, 2015, the parties filed a joint notice of settlement indicating that
the parties had amicably settled the issues relating to an award of attorney's fees and
that no hearing was necessary. On September 9, the hearing officer issued her order
recommending that the Commission close the case based on a private settlement.
Neither party has filed exceptions to that order. Upon consideration, the Commission
hereby accepts the hearing officer's recommendation. Accordingly, this case is
CLOSED.
This order may be appealed to the appropriate district court of appeal. A notice of
appeal must be received by the Commission and the district court of appeal within thirty
days from the date of this order. Except in cases of indigency, the court will require a
filing fee and the Commission will require payment for preparing the record on appeal.

AF-2015-005
(Relates to CA-2014-090)
Further explanation of the right to appeal is provided in Sections 120.68 and 447.504,
Florida Statutes (2015), and the Florida Rules of Appellate Procedure.
It is so ordered.
DELGADO and POOLE, Commissioners, concur.

party on 2015.

SEMINOLE STATE COLLEGE OF RECOMMENDED ORDER
FLORIDA BOARD OF TRUSTEES,
Respondent.
Tobe M. Lev, Orlando, attorney for charging party.
Mark E. Levitt, Winter Park, attorney for respondent.
CROMAR, Hearing Officer.
On September 4, 2015, the parties filed a joint notice of settlement. The notice
states that "the parties amicably resolved the issues relating to an award of attorney's
fees. No hearing is necessary and these matters may be closed." The settlement
agreement was not attached to the parties' notice.
Accordingly, because the parties have settled this case by private agreement, I
transfer this case to the Commission with the recommendation that it close this case.
Any party may file exceptions to my recommended order, but exceptions must be
received by the Commission within fifteen days from the date of this order. See Fla.
Admin. Code Rule 28- 106.217(1).

AF-2015-005
(Relates to CA-2014-090)
.
ISSUED and SUBMITTED to the Public Employees Relations Commission in
accordance with Florida Administrative Code Rule 28- 106.216 and SERVED on all
parties this day of September, 2015.
